description: This file defines an abstract class 'ext_rest' that extends a 'source' class, providing methods to manage URL fetching functionality for REST API connectors within the SuiteCRM system.

classes.name: ext_rest
classes.description: An abstract class that serves as a REST connector, providing URL management and content fetching capabilities for REST API integrations.

methods.name: fetchUrl
methods.description: Fetches content from a specified URL; logs an error if content retrieval fails.

methods.name: getUrl
methods.description: Returns the URL associated with the connector.

methods.name: setUrl
methods.description: Sets the URL for the connector.
